description: This file is a JUnit test class for the ConnectionValidator component in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains numerous test cases validating different aspects of connectivity configuration, such as address validation, acknowledgment labels, certificates, payload mappings, and normalization configurations. It tests the validation logic of the ConnectionValidator class under various scenarios.

classes.name: ConnectionValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for testing the ConnectionValidator class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes setup and teardown for the ActorSystem, and multiple test methods validating connection configurations, address validation, acknowledgment labels, certificates, payload mappings, and normalization logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem before running tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests are completed.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Verifies the immutability of the ConnectionValidator class using MutabilityDetector assertions.

methods.name: acceptValidConnection
methods.description: Tests that a valid connection configuration passes validation successfully.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithSourceWithoutAddresses
methods.description: Ensures that a connection with a source lacking an address is rejected during validation.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithInvalidSourceDeclaredAcks
methods.description: Checks that invalid acknowledgment labels declared in sources cause validation to fail.

methods.name: acceptConnectionWithPlaceholderPrefixedSourceDeclaredAck
methods.description: Validates that acknowledged labels with placeholders are accepted.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithEmptySourceAddress
methods.description: Verifies that sources with empty addresses are rejected.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithEmptyTargetAddress
methods.description: Verifies that targets with empty addresses are rejected.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithInvalidTargetIssuedAck
methods.description: Determines that invalid acknowledged labels issued in targets cause failure.

methods.name: acceptConnectionWithValidSourceDeclaredAcksAndTargetIssuedAcks
methods.description: Ensures valid acknowledgment labels in sources and targets are accepted.

methods.name: acceptConnectionWithValidSourceDeclaredAcksAndTargetIssuedAcksUsingPlaceholder
methods.description: Acceptance of acknowledgment labels with placeholders in sources and targets.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithInvalidNormalizerMapperJsonFieldSelector
methods.description: Tests rejection when a JSON field selector in the normalization mapper is malformed.

methods.name: rejectConnectionWithIllFormedTrustedCertificates
methods.description: Checks that malformed trusted certificates cause validation failure.

methods.name: acceptConnectionWithTrustedCertificates
methods.description: Validates acceptance when properly formatted trusted certificates are provided.

methods.name: rejectIllFormedClientCertificate
methods.description: Ensures that invalid client certificates are rejected.

methods.name: rejectIllFormedClientKey
methods.description: Ensures invalid client keys are rejected.

methods.name: testInvalidHosts
methods.description: Tests address validation logic against various invalid host patterns (wildcards, blocked IPs, localhost, private networks, multicast).
